lead: A `Core` member's refusal is either a `FATAL:` line no `catch` sees or an ordinary `Throwable`; the `Fault::` constructor decides which.
body: `Fault::fatal` (every argument-shape guard in `nvs-stdlib`) unwinds past `catch (Throwable $e)`, so pin it with `--EXPECT-ERROR--` and read the message off `2>`; `Fault::thrown` (`nvs_stdlib::ordering::compare_values`, so `Core\Arr::min`/`sort` over a mixed subject) is caught at file scope. Check the constructor, not the member.
